title: Local edge error
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and assign each vertex a label from the $q$-element alphabet. At a vertex $v$, the local edge error is the uniform average over neighbors $w$ of $v$ of the edge failure indicator for $(v,w)$.
